description: Translate the Sky Fortress briefing and search for the Digimon Flight Team.

english:
It's okay. The
shaking is
real. The Sky
Fortress is
flying toward a
place called
the Energy
Continent.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Huh? This
island moves?
That scared
me... So,
what's the
Energy
Continent like?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
It's the
largest
landmass, right
in the middle
of this Zone.
Digimon from
other Zones
seem to think
the Energy
Continent is
the Elestou
Zone. Most of
ROG's main
forces have
gone there,
too. There
should be lots
of our allies
there, but we
don't know if
they're safe or
where they are
now.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
I see... So
there are
allies there.
We should find
them soon. How
long until we
reach the
Energy
Continent?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english: Well...
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Patamon will
explain in the
Central Room
next door. He's
been waiting
for you to wake
up.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Ha ha... Sorry.
Looks like I
did it again.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
It's fine,
Taiki. I need
you to stay
healthy. And it
seems there's
not much to do
while the
island is
flying, so I
wanted to make
sure you were
in top shape
first. That's
all... I'm
counting on
you, you know!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Yeah, leave it
to me! Thanks
as always,
Akari!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Hmm... Taiki
and Akari,
huh...?
...Never mind.
I'll go tell
Patamon. Come
on, everyone!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
All right,
let's get
going!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Wait, Taiki!
What are you
doing? The ROG
boss isn't this
way!
Ballistamon
said he's in
the back of the
room we were
just in. Let's
hurry in there
and beat him!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Good morning,
Taiki. Sorry to
ask so soon,
but there's
something I
really need you
all to do.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Yeah, I heard.
Leave it to us!
We'll land on
the Energy
Continent and
find our
allies. If most
of ROG is
there, too, we
can't just
leave them
alone. We'll
head out right
away!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Don't get so
worked up that
you collapse
again. You
always say you
can't leave
people in
trouble, but
you're the one
I worry about
most!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
I'll be
careful.
Thanks, Akari.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
So... how do we
get to the
Energy
Continent?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
We're heading
there now,
right? Can't we
just land when
we get there?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
The Sky
Fortress can
fly close to
the continent,
but it can't
land directly
on the ground.
We've never
tried, but we'd
probably crash
and break it.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Then how have
you been
getting there
until now?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
I've got it,
brother! We fly
way up high,
then jump down
from there...
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
...Only Starmon
and Pickmon can
do that.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Darn it! If
Sparrowmon were
here, we could
fly with
DigiXross!
Where did it
go?!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Um, in our
Elestou Zone,
we travel to
other islands
by having a
flying Digimon
Flight Team
carry us!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
But they hid
somewhere when
ROG attacked.
Can you find
out where they
are?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Got it,
Patamon. So...
do you have any
clues?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
All I know is
they're
somewhere on
the Sky
Fortress. For
now, I'll give
you a detailed
map of it. You
can view it by
opening Map on
your Cross
Loader.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Key item
obtained!
Map 01
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
Key item
obtained!
Map 02
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.

english:
We should stay
here on the Sky
Fortress and
help Patamon
and the others.
If it's machine
repairs, leave
it to the
swordsman
Zenjiro!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue and key-item notifications translated directly from Japanese; zone and feature names follow the project glossary.
